input.reasoning_summary:
All three challenges have been refuted by the evidence:

H1 (Different measure of income): The evidence shows that operating income for the nine months ended September 26, 2026 was only $1,182 million (E15), which is far below the $3 billion threshold. Additionally, net income before non-controlling interests was negative $11,609 million (E8, E9), which is even worse than net income attributable to Intel. No alternative income measure exceeds $3 billion.

H2 (Distinction between consolidated and attributable income): The evidence clearly shows that consolidated net income (loss) for the nine months ended September 26, 2026 was negative $11,609 million, while net income (loss) attributable to Intel was negative $11,441 million (E8). Neither figure is positive or exceeds $3 billion.

H3 (Unit or formatting error): The evidence consistently confirms that all figures are stated "In Millions" (E13, E15), and multiple independent passages confirm the same negative $11,441 million figure for net income attributable to Intel for the nine months ended September 26, 2026.

The initial verdict of CONTRADICTED remains correct. Intel reported a net loss attributable to Intel of $11,441 million (i.e., -$11.441 billion) for the nine months ended September 26, 2026, which directly contradicts the claim that Intel earned net income of more than $3 billion during this period.
